issue.title: Doesn't support Shelly 3EM format very well

summary.text: The verifier found that the fixed _normalize_name_in_topic_msg raises AttributeError on a plain Shelly-style topic ('shellies/room/sensor/temperature') because mqtt_exporter.settings has no KEEP_FULL_TOPIC attribute, and two existing tests (test__parse_message__shelly_style and test__parse_message__generic_single_value_style) passed before the fix and fail after it. Look first at the missing KEEP…
